company.shortDescription: Luciq is the first Agentic Mobile Observability Platform, purpose-built to help enterprise teams deliver flawless app experiences at scale.
company.description:
Luciq is the first Agentic Mobile Observability Platform, purpose-built to help enterprise teams deliver flawless app experiences at scale. With intelligent AI agents acting on behalf of developers, Luciq optimizes stability, performance, and workflows across the entire mobile lifecycle so teams can fix nothing and build what matters.

The company was founded in 2014 and headquartered in California, United States.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile observability platform that collects app performance, stability, user feedback, and session data, then helps teams prioritize, diagnose, resolve, and prevent issues across releases.
productsAndServices.name: Luciq Agentic Mobile Observability Platform

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $46,000,000, or 86.6% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,614,921 to $281,159,889, a 77.78x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 43 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 54 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
